title: Now admits when it is stale

text:
Reload `/framework/ai/`. When Now is showing an old thread it says so, in one sentence, with a **Show today** button that switches to the timeline and remembers the choice.

Verified properly this time — both cases, not one:

- **No stored preference:** banner appears, click switches the view, preference saves.
- **`now` genuinely stored** (clicked timeline, then Now, so the app wrote it itself): banner still appears.
- After the click the tab strip now highlights **timeline**, where it was still highlighting Now an hour ago.
- Zero console errors.

I said earlier I hadn't proven the stored-preference case. Now I have — and the reason my first attempt failed is worth keeping: on a fresh load `localStorage` is genuinely **empty**, so an absent key and a key set to null read identically through a guessed selector. The real key is `lew42:v3-view`.

That's twice today a guessed selector nearly produced a false conclusion. Both times the fix was the same: drive the app into the state instead of fabricating the state underneath it.

**Still yours:** the fast assistant isn't running, which is why your words never became cards today. This makes the symptom visible and honest; it doesn't replace that tab.
